newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines says forex reserves up at $11.6 bln.
newsitem.headline: Philippines says forex reserves up at $11.6 bln.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Thursday its gross international reserves had reached $11.6 billion as of November 20, up from $11.4 billion by the end of September.

"Improved economic fundamentals, lower inflation, higher exports, investments and increased worker remittances for the Christmas holidays have steadily brought up the forex reserves to the all-time high record," the bank statement said.
The Central Bank's reserves are in cash, short-term Treasury bills and gold.
The bank also said foreign currency deposit units of commercial banks have reached $13.2 billion as of November 8, up from $9.014 billion registered a year ago.
The statement attributed the expansion of the foreign currency deposit units to the high remittances of overseas Filipino workers.
